moves.name: Tackle
moves.desc: Charges in an arc at everything in front of you.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.desc: You dash at the enemy like lightning and hit everything on the way.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.desc: Deals no damage: builds ATTACK while active.

moves.name: Agility
moves.desc: Deals no damage: builds SPEED while active.

moves.name: Harden
moves.desc: Deals no damage: builds DEFENSE while active.

moves.name: Ember
moves.desc: A fireball at the nearest enemy.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.desc: A short fan of flames that burns.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.desc: Flames that spin around you. Constant defense.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.desc: Explodes in flames in every direction.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.desc: A piercing jet. Reliable at any range.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.desc: A fan of bubbles that slows whatever they touch.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.desc: A slow but devastating water blast.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.desc: Deals no damage: builds health REGENERATION.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.desc: Long-range whips in a wide arc.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.desc: Two leaves that fly out and back, cutting both ways.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.desc: A cyclone of leaves spins widely around you.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.desc: Roots that snare and pound everything near you.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.desc: A lightning-fast bolt that pierces several enemies.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.desc: A permanent electric field around you.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.desc: A bolt that jumps from one enemy to the next.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.desc: A wave that homes in on its target.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.desc: A wide, heavy-hitting psychic beam.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.desc: A radial mental burst that seeks enemies.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.desc: Hypnotic waves that can put nearby enemies to sleep.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.desc: Devours dreams: only hits sleeping enemies, deals big damage and heals you.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.desc: Toxic sludge that poisons on impact.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.desc: Splashes mud around and slows foes.

moves.name: Gust
moves.desc: Whirlwinds that escort you.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.desc: A wide wing sweep that pushes foes back.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.desc: A full-weight tackle: slow, short and brutal.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.desc: A sound wave that spreads in every direction.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.desc: A quick poisonous sting.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.desc: You leave pools of poison that badly poison whoever steps on them.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.desc: Shakes the ground: damages and slows everything nearby.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.desc: A quick bite in a short arc.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.desc: Leaves webs on the ground that trap and greatly slow whoever steps on them.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.desc: A constant vibration that pounds everything nearby.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.desc: A heavy boulder that pushes the enemy back.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.desc: Rocks fall from the sky onto nearby enemies.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.desc: An icy beam that almost freezes foes solid.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.desc: A blizzard around you that slows foes.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.desc: A sharp, powerful blow straight ahead.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.desc: An energy sphere that never misses.

moves.name: Lick
moves.desc: A ghostly lick that briefly paralyzes.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.desc: A shadowy orb that pierces several foes.

moves.name: Dragon Rage
moves.desc: Draconic flames in a straight line.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.desc: Deals no damage: builds ATTACK faster than Swords Dance.

moves.name: Fairy Wind
moves.desc: A magical breeze in every direction.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.desc: A flash of light all around you.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.desc: A steel swipe in an arc.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.desc: A piercing beam of metallic light.

moves.name: Bite
moves.desc: A quick bite that knocks foes back.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.desc: A wave of dark energy in every direction.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.desc: A shadow surrounds you and consumes what is near.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.desc: A bone that flies out and back, hitting hard.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.desc: Psychic blades that come back to you.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.desc: Scatters spikes that burst when stepped on.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.desc: Poison spikes that badly poison when they burst.

moves.name: Hail
moves.desc: Hailstones fall on enemies and slow them.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.desc: Two steel meteors that crush where they land.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.desc: Leaves a floating flame that fires on its own and burns.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.desc: A decoy that stays behind shooting for you.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.desc: You dive and slash everything you pass through.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.desc: You run wrapped in fire, leaving a trail of flames.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.desc: A short fan of bubbles that slows.

moves.name: Hex
moves.desc: A curse that jumps between enemies. Much more damage if they are burned, poisoned, slowed or under any status effect.

zmoves.name: Starlight Dash
zmoves.desc: You charge three times at full speed through the enemies, piercing everything in your path.

zmoves.name: Pyrotechnic Holocaust
zmoves.desc: A rain of fireballs falls on the enemies.

zmoves.name: Abyssal Hydro Vortex
zmoves.desc: A giant vortex drags enemies toward the center and a final wave hurls them away.

zmoves.name: Gigavolt Storm
zmoves.desc: Three bolts jump from enemy to enemy in a chain, paralyzing them and growing stronger each time.

zmoves.name: Cataclysmic Bloom
zmoves.desc: Roots immobilize enemies and squeeze them, and when they bloom you heal for each one.

zmoves.name: Absolute Zero
zmoves.desc: Freezes every enemy on screen and a final blow shatters them all at once.

zmoves.name: Total Crush
zmoves.desc: You leap at the strongest enemy and unleash a flurry of blows ending with a devastating uppercut.

zmoves.name: Acid Deluge
zmoves.desc: Acid pools appear among the enemies and poison them while they stand inside.

zmoves.name: Tectonic Fury
zmoves.desc: Cracks open from you in every direction and crush whoever stands on them.

zmoves.name: Supersonic Dive
zmoves.desc: You vanish into the sky and dive down on the biggest group of enemies.

zmoves.name: Shattered Mind
zmoves.desc: Enemies become confused and attack each other.

zmoves.name: Devastating Plague
zmoves.desc: A swarm of insects hunts the enemies on its own, one bug per target.

zmoves.name: Continental Avalanche
zmoves.desc: A rockslide sweeps across the screen from side to side, pushing everything in its way.
zmoves.mission: Clear floor 8 of the Floor Tower.

zmoves.name: Eternal Nightmare
zmoves.desc: You drain the enemies' souls: they lose life based on their health and you heal.

zmoves.name: Draconic Cataclysm
zmoves.desc: Four draconic beams spin at high speed around you while you are invincible.

zmoves.name: Abyssal Eclipse
zmoves.desc: Darkness closes in on you in a shrinking circle and ends in an implosion.

zmoves.name: Metal Drill
zmoves.desc: You drill in a straight line through everything with a steel drill and finish with an explosion.
zmoves.mission: Survive 8 minutes in Survival by Type.

zmoves.name: Dreamy Flash
zmoves.desc: You put every enemy to sleep and heal; at the end you devour their dreams and heal more for each one.

mods.name: No healing
mods.desc: You can't recover health (only what Health upgrades give you).

rests.name: Training
rests.desc: You get an extra upgrade right now.

rests.name: Shield
rests.desc: A shield worth 35% of your health absorbs damage on the next floor.

risks.name: Frenzy
risks.desc: You attack 25% faster, but take 20% more damage.

risks.name: Glass cannon
risks.desc: +20% damage, but your max health drops by 15%.

risks.name: Light feet
risks.desc: You move 20% faster, but enemies are also 10% faster.

risks.name: Blood pact
risks.desc: You recover 2 HP for every Pokémon defeated, but bosses hit 20% harder.

risks.name: Forbidden knowledge
risks.desc: +50% experience, but enemies have 20% more health.

risks.name: Stone skin
risks.desc: You take 25% less damage, but move 15% slower.

risks.name: Boss contract
risks.desc: +50% coins per floor, but bosses have 25% more health.

risks.name: Fasting
risks.desc: +15% damage, but berries and the rest heal restore 45% less.

risks.name: Call of the horde
risks.desc: +12% damage and +20% experience, but 30% more enemies appear.

risks.name: Quick hands
risks.desc: Your cooldown drops by 30%, but your damage drops by 10%.

risks.name: Charged blows
risks.desc: +22% damage, but your cooldown rises by 20%.

risks.name: Overclock
risks.desc: Your cooldown drops by 25%, but your max health drops by 10%.

risks.name: Frantic rhythm
risks.desc: Your cooldown drops by 20%, but 15% more enemies appear.

risks.name: Slow burn
risks.desc: Your cooldown rises by 15%, but you take 25% less damage and regenerate 1 HP per second.

risks.name: Blind fury
risks.desc: You attack 15% faster and deal +10% damage, but take 10% more damage.

legends.name: Time mastery
legends.desc: Your cooldown drops by 70%. No cost.

legends.name: Double baggage
legends.desc: You can carry 2 items at once (for example Leftovers and Shell Bell) and you get one right now. No cost.

legends.name: Thirst for victory
legends.desc: Every Pokémon you defeat permanently increases your damage by 0.30%. No cost.

legends.name: Legendary armor
legends.desc: Your defense rises by 60%. No cost.

adaptive.desc: In normal runs, the game starts easy and gets harder as you upgrade: more enemy health and damage, more enemies, more frequent hordes and more experience needed per level.

minimap.name: Minimap
minimap.desc: The round map on the left: the ground you have explored, nearby enemies, chests and altars, bosses and the rift.

missions.text: Survive 3 minutes with a Fire-type Pokémon
Defeat 2 / 4 bosses in the Boss Rush
Survive 4 / 6 minutes with any modifier active
Survive 4 / 6 minutes in Survival by Type
Clear 2 / 3 floors of the Floor Tower
Win 2 / 3 rifts in the Rift Time Attack
Defeat 6 / 9 bosses in a single Boss Rush run
Survive 8 / 12 minutes in Survival by Type
Clear 6 / 9 floors of the Floor Tower in a single run
Win 5 / 7 rifts in a single Rift Time Attack
Survive 6 / 8 minutes with 3 or more modifiers

status.name: Frozen
status.desc: The enemy can't move or attack and takes 25% more damage. Bosses resist it.

status.name: Paralyzed
status.desc: The enemy moves much slower and takes more Electric damage. Bosses resist it.

status.name: Asleep
status.desc: The enemy doesn't act, takes 30% more damage and wakes up on the first hit. Darkrai is immune.

status.name: Confused
status.desc: The enemy wanders aimlessly and attacks other enemies. Bosses resist it.

status.name: Burned
status.desc: Damage over time, and the enemy deals less damage.

status.name: Poisoned
status.desc: Damage over time based on its max HP (less against bosses).

status.name: Slowed
status.desc: The enemy moves slower for a while.

strings: Sign in to play with friends
Relay time is used up for today; players who can't connect directly can't continue. Direct connections still work.
